title: Any plugin s to add timed inputs to attack animations?

posts.author: Ju_De
posts.body: Kinda like the Mario RPG series, where you can time a button press during an attack animation to amplify damage and whatnot. Are there any plugins that do this?

posts.author: SGHarlekin
posts.body:
Depends on what you want, but here are 2 that achieve timed inputs in pretty much any way.
Sequence Input - SomeRanDev RPG Maker MV Plugin
This Plugin requires Yanfly’s Battle Engine Core and Yanfly’s Action Sequences (#1)  (#2)  (#3)
someran.dev
https://someran.dev/rpgmaker/plugins/mv/SRD_TimedAttackCore.js/
